title: Cave Diver
brief: Steer a diver with the joystick down two flooded caves while air drains every second; catch rising bubbles for air, grab the shell key and open the clam to clear the way to the grotto. Run out of air or lose three lives to the eels and the dive is over.

title: Constellation Scout
brief: Fly a scout rocket around a big star field with the joystick and trace six stars in order; each lit star wakes the next one, and lighting all six reveals the home dock. Fuel drains as you fly (green cells refill it, the purple moth steals it), comets cost lives, and an empty tank or a breached hull ends the run.

title: Orchard at Dusk
brief: Drag the picker along a long orchard gathering apples that drop under the trees (the basket holds five) and carry each full basket back to the cart; four crates win. Crows steal an apple per swoop and get faster at dusk, apples rot if left lying, and nightfall ends the harvest.

title: Flood Ferry
brief: Pilot a rescue boat with the joystick through three flooded districts and pick up every stranded person before their time runs out; the floodgate to the next district opens only when nobody is left waiting. Drifting logs and anyone swept away cost lives, whirlpools drag you back to the start, and the ferry sinks when the lives run out.

title: Echo Caves
brief: Find your way through two pitch-dark caves whose walls are solid but invisible: tap anywhere to send an echo that lights the rock for a moment (echoes are limited, glow-worms give them back). Fetch the key to open the way out, then the hidden crystal that only shines in an echo; bats cost lives and three bites leave you lost in the dark.

title: Lantern Rooftops
brief: Swipe left, right or up to leap across a long row of night-time rooftops and touch all six lamp posts to light them; with every lamp burning the bell tower opens and reaching it wins. Falling into an alley, the rooftop cat and chimney smoke each cost a life, and four losses end the night.

title: Glacier Slide
brief: Swipe to send a penguin sliding across three frozen lakes; it only stops at a rock, the shore or the edge, so plan each slide to reach the igloo (lake 2 needs the golden fish to melt the ice gate). Every swipe costs a move, fish and igloos give moves back, cracked ice and the seal reset the lake, and running out of moves ends the game.

title: Station Blackout
brief: Explore two dark station decks with the joystick, reading terminals for hints, and collect three fuses on each (one behind a keycard door); power opens the bulkheads and lights guide arrows to the lift, then to the escape pod. Oxygen drains all the time, and drones, a chaser and a flickering power arc cost lives.

title: Lighthouse Oil
brief: Drag the keeper up the winding lighthouse stairs collecting three cans of oil (each one slows you down) to open the hatch to the lamp room, then reach the lamp to win. Sea spray bursting through the windows costs a life; lose three and you are swept off the stairs.

title: Mole Tunnels
brief: Swipe to steer a mole that digs through a deep column of soil, stopping only at rocks and the edges; worms hidden in the soil give themselves away with a wriggle, and finding six fills the larder and wins. Pockets of marsh gas lie hidden too: dig into three and the mole is done.

title: Desert Wells
brief: Lead a camel east across a long desert with the joystick while a sandstorm rolls in behind you; water drains as you go, so detour to the wells (each gives water once) and dodge the scorpions that drink your supply. Reach the oasis to win; dying of thirst or being caught by the storm ends the trek.

title: Reef Census
brief: Swim a little fish around a large reef with the joystick and photograph six species by touching them: a wandering turtle, a fast ray, a seahorse among the jellyfish, an octopus that only peeks out of its ink now and then, a shy crab that hides when you arrive (wait and it comes back) and the shark, which chases anyone entering its lair. Jellyfish stings and shark bites cost lives; three and the census is over.

title: Ghost Manor
brief: Drag your explorer through three floors of a haunted manor and tap the portraits to look behind them: one hides the key to the stairs, the rest let a ghost out. On the top floor, light all four candles to make the bookcase slide aside and reach the front door; ghosts, the maid and the butler cost lives, and four losses keep you in the manor.

title: Shrink Spores
brief: Steer a seed sprite through two garden levels with the joystick: blue caps shrink you for a few seconds so you can slip through narrow gaps in the hedges, red caps make you huge so you can smash cracked logs and squash beetles. Find the acorn key to open the burrow; beetles hurt you at normal or small size, and three hits end the run.

title: Sluice Gardens
brief: Canals cut two long water gardens into strips: tap the sluice levers to drain a canal and walk its bed for the seeds hidden under the water, but most levers flood the canal behind you, so pull them in the right order (they toggle back if you get it wrong). Four seeds open the first greenhouse and five more the second; the flamingos cost lives and three pecks end the visit.
